meta.title: About us
meta.description: Meet Codex: one agency with dedicated development, brand and marketing teams that build digital products and grow businesses.

hero.title: We build what helps businesses grow
hero.description: A digital agency of engineers, designers and marketers who work as one team, from the first idea to steady growth.

story.title: Started by builders, grown with our clients

paragraphs.first: Codex began with a simple observation: businesses were hiring one company for their website, another for their brand and a third for their marketing, and paying for the gaps between them.
paragraphs.second: So we brought those skills under one roof. Today our development, brand and marketing teams plan every project together, share one timeline and measure success by the same numbers.
paragraphs.third: We have helped stores, schools, startups and established companies launch, rebrand and grow, and many of them still work with us years later.

missionVision.mission: To give every business the technology, brand and marketing it needs to compete, delivered by one team that cares about the result.
missionVision.vision: To be the partner growing brands in the region trust first to build and scale their digital presence.
